summary: Clean Flatpak browser caches (Firefox, Edge) in fixos cleanup

delivery.outcome: fixos cleanup finds and safely removes Firefox and Edge caches installed as Flatpak (~/.var/app/<app-id>/cache), which were invisible before.
nonGoals: Cleaning Flatpak app data outside the browser HTTP cache directory (profiles, ~/.var/app/*/cache/tmp, other apps).

architecture.decision: Add the Flatpak XDG cache paths of Firefox and Edge to ServiceDataScanner.SERVICE_PATHS and to the matching rm -rf commands in ServiceCleaner.get_cleanup_command; risk level stays SAFE as for the non-Flatpak caches.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching service_scanner.py and service_cleanup.py.

validation.evidence: New Flatpak cache tests and existing cleanup tests pass; governance-check passes.
